name: Riot Shield
description: A held shield that bounces bullets back and fires waves of shots.
details: Your gun becomes a shield held in front of you that bounces enemy bullets back like your block. It takes 4 hits, then turns red and recharges for 3 s (an intact shield regains a hit every 2.5 s). Fire sends a wave of your normal bullets (your bullets per shot, with all your bullet effects); hold to add a bullet every 0.35 s, up to 5 more. Each wave costs 1 ammo.
